name: securbrowser-toolkit
description: Browser-side authenticated file encryption and interoperable encrypted 7z archives.

scripts.build:public: npm run vendor:sevenzip && npm run vendor:sevenzip:check
scripts.lint: eslint public/assets/js tests scripts playwright.config.js playwright.interop.config.js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run build:public && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:e2e:built
scripts.check: npm run lockfile:check && npm run layout:check && npm run deps:production && npm run build:public && npm run validate:html && npm run test:unit && npm run test:wasm && npm run lint && npm run style:check
scripts.check:offline: npm run layout:check && npm run deps:production && npm run style:check && npm run validate:html:static && npm run test:unit && node scripts/self-test.mjs
